date_scope_check.qualification: R2-EA-008-D1: Contemporary throughput accounts conflict: a shared official/press passage says hundreds, the named border-guard interview says just over 20 by early afternoon and first traffic near noon, and the evening city report records 46 vehicles. These counts are not harmonized or treated as independent confirmation. April 26 establishes first partial cargo restoration, excluding cold-chain goods at that stage. A June 17 city report explicitly records a Dongxing agreement restoring cold-chain clearance at Bac Luan II and Km3+4 from June 17 and reports citywide cargo restoration. The later national-government tonnage figure concerns Km3+4, not Bac Luan II; no exact first refrigerated truck at Bac Luan II is established. Passenger admission remains outside this phase.
